summary.summary: * Food aid distribution has commenced in the Tigray Region by international aid agencies. [Source](https://reliefweb.int/report/ethiopia/food-aid-distribution-begins-tigray-region)* The water shortage crisis is worsening in the Somali Region, requiring urgent action due to persistent drought. [Source](https://www.unocha.org/ethiopia)* A displacement camp in Amhara has received essential medical supplies. [Source](https://www.who.int/countries/eth/)* An urgent appeal has been issued for nutrition support in Afar as child malnutrition rates are rising alarmingly. [Source](https://www.unicef.org/ethiopia/)* Heavy rains have caused widespread flooding, displacing thousands of families in the Gambela Region. [Source](https://ethiopia.iom.int/)
